pages.text: Living Realms ties into other kingdom mods when they are installed. Nothing changes when one is missing.$(br2)The $(l)Overview$() page then shows a $(l)Pack$() strip: feudal title, ruler, siege train, Workers staff and recovered gear. Hover each for details.

Every part can be switched off in $(l)serverconfig/livingrealms-server.toml$() under $(l)compat$():$(li)feudalTitles, feudalOaths, rankTitles$(li)siegeTrains, npcSiegeTrains$(li)raiderAlarm, morale$(li)workersStaffTowns, corpseSalvage$(li)heraldryGear
